adversarial.description: Evaluator-originated live-index probe (not one of the contract's 13 verification commands and not S05's whole-file fixture substitution). In a scratch copy only, scratch_run replaces the single tools/skill.json module pin "standard/anti_hallucination.md" (capabilities[9], name anti_hallucination) with "ecosystem/README.md", a file that exists and is not an authoritative_source. The copy must fail the full sweep with exactly the C13 subset detail, no 'does not resolve' line, and no [C4] FAIL. The probe then writes the original module string back, requires git diff --quiet against HEAD for tools/skill.json, and requires a second validate.sh to exit 0 with [C13] PASS and no [C13] FAIL. The real worktree's tools/skill.json is never written. Helper: .agent/evidence/106/qa/adversarial_restore_probe.sh, invoked only as the scratch_run command.
